description: This file implements functions for managing the freezer cgroup subsystem, including setting, getting, reading freezer state, and waiting for the freezer to reach a frozen state.

methods.name: setFreezer
methods.description: Sets the freezer state (frozen or thawed) for a cgroup at the specified directory path.

methods.name: getFreezer
methods.description: Retrieves the current freezer state of a cgroup at the specified directory path.

methods.name: readFreezer
methods.description: Reads the freezer state from the provided file descriptor, returning the corresponding cgroups.FreezerState.

methods.name: ignoreNotExistOrNoDeviceError
methods.description: Checks if an error is due to a non-existent cgroup or missing device, and returns nil if so.

methods.name: waitFrozen
methods.description: Polls the cgroup.events file until the freezer state is 'frozen' or times out.
